# Motify

> Motify makes motion graphics easier for businesses, marketing teams, and agencies. Describe an idea, attach your images or music, or start from a template, and Motify creates an animated ad, product animation, explainer video, or social content that you refine by chatting with its AI assistant, Tiffy, then export.

Motify runs in the browser at https://app.motify.video. Motify is a Cambodian-led startup. It is built for businesses, marketing teams, and agencies who want motion graphics without learning complex software or getting caught in long production handoffs. AI helps with the production; you bring the ideas, creative direction, and judgment.

Key facts:

- What it makes: animated ads, product animations, explainer videos, launch and announcement videos, product demos, and marketing and social content.
- How it works: start from a prompt, a website link, or a template. An AI pipeline understands the intent, plans scenes and pacing as a creative director, sharpens the messaging (for example Problem → Agitation → Solution), generates the animation, and runs a quality check before returning it.
- Refine by prompting: ask Tiffy in plain language to change the hook, copy, pacing, scenes, music, or visual direction, and the same project updates. There is no timeline or keyframe tool to learn.
- Inputs: prompts, website links, images and logos, uploaded music, and motion templates from the template gallery.
- Brand: a Brand DNA / brand kit (typeface, voice, logo) is applied to every scene.
- Output: HD MP4 exports in 16:9, 1:1, 4:5, and 9:16. Finished videos can be used commercially, including paid ads.
- Pricing: credit-based plans (Free, Starter, Pro, Enterprise). A typical AI generation uses about 10 credits; a complete video commonly takes about three generations. Free to start, no card required. Payments are one-time via Bakong KHQR and do not auto-renew.
- Built by COPPSARY.
